# std/mod

> % : remainder (sign follows the left operand, like C)

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/mod.pkg) · translated by [bintables/mod](../bintables/mod.md)

Remainder, with the sign of the left operand (like C). A zero divisor crashes the program.

```
print 7 % 3     // 1
print -7 % 3    // -1
```

Infix, precedence 60, left-associative. Both operands must be `int`; the
result is `int`.

## Syntax

Kind: `infix`, precedence 60, left-associative

```
{left: expr int} % {right: expr int} -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `left` | expression | `int` |
| `right` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
